notes.title: Important changes in version 0.7.5
notes.notes:
After a long period work on game I decided to make some important changes to the game to make it easier for players to understand. 

Kill report option added (walkie-talkie removed).

The phone no longer goes through hand.

Eleman the assassin character added.

Unique features and visuals based on the anomaly genre have been polished.

A question mark (?) has been added next to the reporting button. It helps if you forgot about all rules of anomalies.

Overall improvements for clarity.

Demo players will not affected majorly from this changes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593857/d265bf89141ff991e0414b1f188e09fefc134b98.png"]

Also square IP CHANGE buttons explained in the new trailer. Check it out.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593857/77f3ec7781226bdb5afe0c482811f432496e55b2.png"]

For more information, check out the new Steam page and new trailer.

 If you have any criticism, no matter if it's bad or small, please share it in our community.

notes.title: 0.5.0 MAJOR UPDATE IS UP!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



I've been working on an update for a long time, and after two months it is up.



First of all, thanks for the 1,130 wishlists that came from scratch. Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends so it can be released early. I plan to release full game when we reach at least 5,000. During this time I will keep work on the game.


0.5.0ea Patch Notes

GAMEPLAY
Added new hidden our team's spy character "Detective Ronald"

Added more detailed long tutorials with animations.

The game design and messages at our computer were polished for all missions.

Model Mia now more easy and not disappearing at the normal mode.

Now player can see missed anomaly report count in the result screen. Also can see all available anomaly count in the mission. The previously reported anomaly number is saved.

Player can select favorite mode between two missions now.

OBSERVE CAMERAS AND COMPLETE FILE TRANSFER \[MAIN GAME MODE]

Added 2D walkie-talkie that can connect to our spy team's stations in specific body cameras from CamFly application.

Added "shooting & killing" report option from a local body camera. Requires walkie-talkie.

Added new hidden character "Baron Boriss".

Added new criminal "Benjamin".

Added "special developed phone" item that shows the distance of the killer.

Added "sensor" system that can help for closing the truck door for a while.

Added new camera called "Staircases".

A "router" system connected to the office's data center has been added. You'll enter a password and configure it during the game.

Added a message to computer from anonymous666.

ChatApp application now has a sound and alert.

Now when the killer and some others are in the office they text us on our computer.

FINDING SECRET FILES \[SIDE GAME MODE]

The old mission has been polished, and the main item to be found has been changed to "The Secret Files." When you pick up the secret file box, an explosive component detonates, and the bomb sound now plays after 2 seconds, allowing the killer to hear you after a delay. \[Note: old demo players may be confused. This change is more in line with the game's theme than the teddy bear.]

Grey Keycard, Red Keycard items added.


LEVEL DESIGN
Notes board changed at the truck.

Small decoration changes at the truck.

Added a new metal door to data center rooms.

Polished some models and characters.

Some door materials changed.


AUDIO & SFX
Now you can change your mic device during a co-op match from settings.

UI Sound changes.

New door sounds added.

Ambient sounds added to outside and secret surveillance cameras.

Players can now hear everyone in voice chat at close range on the end-game results screen.
MINOR FIXES
Simple lobby fixes.

Sensitivity setting problem fixed.

Inventory based simple fixes.

Elevator problem fixed.

Player's head no longer passes out the vent.
NAVIGATION
The voice chat key now can change.

The game now pauseable in single player mode.



If you encounter any bugs, feel free to report them in the steam discussions or join me and the others over at Discord.



Thanks.

Have fun
